review.scope: Tripo's own render and the raw model's heights
review.notes: Tripo's render showed the sacks, amphorae and rope heaped on a four-wheeled cart of their own, which the request ('as it would sit on a cart bed') had invited. In the raw model the wheels rise above the bed and the amphorae lie at its edge, so no horizontal cut takes the cart away without cutting the load. Redone as g5-cart-load-b, its prompt describing only the heap lying on the ground and the cart left to the negative prompt.
